message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        script: [test:types, test:import, test:browser, test:node]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run ${{ matrix.script }}",
  "rationale": "Add a custom job timeout of 5 minutes to bound execution and prevent runaway CI consumption. The workflow currently has no timeout. Repository CI history shows successful runs complete in 30-40 seconds (e.g., run 45616505848: 44s; 45071139599: 47s), so a 5-minute limit provides ample headroom while capping pathological cases. This optimization is directly supported by experiment examples for P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (26.8% elapsed savings) and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT (6.25% savings), both of which added `timeout-minutes: 5` to similar single-job workflows with Node.js setup and npm test steps. The change preserves all test coverage and matrix behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-a14b642d809bf336"]
}
